reviews.text:
Hello Willian,
Thank you very much for these 5 stars!

Kind regards
Village Vets Raheny

A lovely team here who took great care of my little yorkie Charlie this week.  Such kindness and professionalism from Sorcha,  Jenny,  Emma, Shane and Shauna. Sorry if I forgot anyone and thank you for making a difficult time easier 💕
Excellent from start to finish, Level of care was 10/10, would highly recommend.

Can’t recommend Village Vets Raheny and the incredible team highly enough. I have a very spicy 🌶️ 6 year old cat and the team are so patient and kind when she has been in for a visit. Also amazing front of house support with food and medication. It’s great to have this practice in the area and this well fed lady agrees! …

The kindness and compassion Charlotte the vet showed my family yesterday is beyond anything I've ever experienced. She was so professional and understanding as we made the choice to put our 17 year old Shitzu to sleep. We're so grateful to have this fantastic vets in our local area, would definitely recommend 100% to anyone who wants the best care for their fur babies 💙

Hello Suzanne,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us these 5 stars.
It means a lot to our team.

Kind regards
Village Vets Raheny
Super service from a fantastic team. Sorcha and the team in Raheny are excellent at what they do. Can't recommend this practice highly enough.
I had a great experience dealing with all the staff at Village Vets Raheny. Sorcha and her team are amazing and went above and beyond for me and Mochara
Great veterinary clinic with fantastic friendly staff
One of the best sites of Village Vets. They are professional and they always look after our cats well. Sorcha is very kind and helpful. Thank you so much for your service 🙏

I was recommend here by my friend as I wasn't satisfied with my last vet and I'm so so glad I switched. Everyone here is super friendly and passionate, you can tell they really care for their patients. I really appreciate the informative follow up calls and emails I've received after my doggy Albert needed some x-rays. It's comforting to feel like my pet is being thoroughly cared for and that my concerns are valid :) Great service, lovely team
The best vets I have been to so far. They are extremely thorough and communicative. Many thanks to Charlotte and the whole team.

We've been visiting Village Vets Raheny since January 2026, when we rescued Leshy (formerly Brownie). They have supported us through every challenge along the way, and we're incredibly grateful for all the care and kindness they've shown. Even though we have to take a taxi to get there, it's worth every trip.

A special thank you to Charlotte, who always takes the time to answer all of our questions in detail. We really appreciate her patience, understanding, and reassurance during what was often a very stressful time for us. Thank you as well to Shauna, who is always so kind and takes such great care of our cats. Not only Leshy, but our other two cats, Ellie and Jago, are now patients here as well.

At our last visit, all three cats were healthy, which made us so happy. Leshy will be back soon for his tail procedure, but apart from that, everyone is doing really well. The cats are still getting to know each other, so becoming one happy family is still a work in progress..but they're making slow and steady progress.

Thank you again to the whole team for everything you've done for us and our cats. We truly appreciate it!
What a lovely practice , warm, friendly professional welcome to both myself & my dog, Peig. Sorcha gave Peig a clean bill of doggie health ..& Peig will be returning for her regular checkup's
Friendly staff and prompt professional service
Fist time to use this vets in raheny. Recommend by a family member. Staff very nice and very helpful.
Sorcha was fantastic with my dog. She also explained everything really well, discussed options of treatments and the prices. No nasty surprises with the bill

I'm grateful for Village Vets Raheny to be Lulu's regular veterinary team. Sorcha was the first to notify me that what was once a mild heart murmur progressed in stage and we were able to get the necessary tests completed to keep my baby girl as healthy as possible. The team are always kind, professional, and helpful, whether we're in clinic or on the phone. Incredibly happy to have them near and to be a part of the Village Vets network! x

We went in to Beaumont on Saturday because once again my puppy ate something dodgy.  The vet saw him within a few mins and we went to Dundrum for X-rays. Both teams were brilliant to deal with & sorted him out. They are very efficient & always so friendly!
Thank you, from Ernie 🐾

Have been going to village vets raheny for about 12 weeks now tobi loves going as he has ear problems every 2 weeks finally getting better lovely vets and staff great pet plan would diffenly recommend thank you
